read.description: Read one file as numbered lines. Use PDF pages/pdf_mode or Office cursors for structured documents; pass Partial: next_start_line=N as start_line to continue. Read scope defaults to unrestricted; normal scope permits the session root and approved extension roots.

grep.description: Search files with Rust regex, or literal text with fixed_strings=true. Narrow with glob/type/mode and continue Partial: next_offset=N with offset. Read scope defaults to unrestricted; normal scope permits the session root and approved extension roots.

glob.description: Find files or directories with a bounded case-sensitive glob. Use an array for include/exclude patterns and continue Partial: next_offset=N with offset. Read scope defaults to unrestricted; normal scope permits the session root and approved extension roots.

run_program.description: Run one executable with literal argv and no shell. A nonzero exit is returned with its status and output; process access is independent from read scope. Use bash for pipelines, redirection, or shell composition.

bash.description: Run non-interactive POSIX Bash and return merged output plus exit status. Process access is independent from read scope. MCP long work uses detach=true with a repository-local log_path, then bash_status; DSH long work uses run_in_background=true, requires a short description, then bash_status.

bash_status.description: Inspect the lifecycle and final outcome of the job ID returned by a background bash call; MCP returns bounded log pages while DSH returns the official job snapshot. Repeat until terminal status.

canonicalCodePolicy.mapped: Use one of errorCodes for shared cross-adapter semantics.
canonicalCodePolicy.unmappedMcp: Preserve the legacy MCP error class in canonicalCode until a versioned mapping is added.

mcp.errorCode: legacy MCP class; compare error.canonicalCode for v1 semantics
